sources.title: Fair Trade Commission franchise brand list (가맹정보 브랜드 목록 정보 제공 서비스), base years 2017-2025
sources.note: Korea Fair Trade Commission via data.go.kr, 이용허락범위 제한 없음. Collected by tools/lexicon/brands/collect_ftc.py; only brand names registered with both a Hangul and a Latin form are used, and the Hangul form counts only when it is phonetically related to the written name. Registered names are the franchisor's own spelling, not pronunciation authority; no synthesized audio.
